name: sponge-removal-notifies
comment: WP-1.6g. BlockSponge: onBlockAdded only reads (BlockSponge.java:9-21, vanilla bug: empty if), onBlockRemoval notifies the neighbours of every block in the 5x5x5 box (BlockSponge.java:23-34). Sponge at (0, 61, 0) on a stone platform at y = 60. Four sand blocks on stone supports (placed silently; their onBlockAdded ticks find support at t = 3); at t = 5 the supports are removed silently, so the sand floats. At t = 10 the sponge is removed silently (setBlockAndMetadata still runs the old block's onBlockRemoval, Chunk.java:236-273): sand at (3, 63, 0) (neighbour of box block (2, 63, 0)) and (0, 64, 0) (neighbour of (0, 63, 0)) are notified, schedule a tick and fall as EntityFallingSand; (5, 63, 0) and (0, 66, 0) are outside the reach and keep floating.
